name: Yellen Payment Gateway For WooCommerce
author: yellen5

sections.installation:
Automated installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option, as WordPress will handle the file transfer and you won’t need to leave your web browser.
Note: Ensure the WooCommerce plugin is pre-installed prior to initiating the steps in this guide.

  1. Install the plugin via the “Plugins” section in the Dashboard
    1.1. Click on “Add new” and search for “yellen Payment Gateway for WooCommerce”
    1.2. Then click on the “Install Now” button
    1.3. Click “Activate” to active the plugin
  2. Follow the instructions on the yellen pop-up window appearing in the plugin setting screen and use the “Connect Account” button to initiate the connection with your yellen account

Manual Installation

The manual installation method involves downloading our plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favorite FTP application. WordPress contains instructions on how to do this.
sections.faq:
Does it work with debit and credit card?

Yes. You’ll be able to accept Visa, VPay, Mastercard, American Express, Diners Club, Discover cards.

What currencies does the plugin support?

We support 16 currencies with more being added.

Which Alternative Payment Methods (APMs) are supported?

At yellen you can process online payments with Multicaixa Express. Read more about our APMs in our official developer documentation.

How can I enable Alternative Payment Methods (APMs)?

Our Support team will enable the APMs that are relevant to your business location. Reach out to us through our contact form for assistance.

Where can I find documentation?

You can find all the information you’ll need on how to set up your plugin here.

Where can I get support if needed?

If you have any questions, please get in contact with us through our contact form.

Does this support both production mode and sandbox mode for testing?

Yes. If you need a testing environment, please contact us through our contact form.

sections.description:
Accept payments with Yellen on WooCommerce. Fast, secure checkout and easy setup for your store.

External services

This plugin connects to external services to process payments and manage onboarding:

  • API: https://bo-jaja.yellen-corp.com

    • Purpose: payment interface.
    • Data sent: order ID to retrieve payment interface.
    • Terms/Privacy: https://jaja.yellen-corp.com/ (see service terms and privacy policy).

  • API: https://yellen.runasp.net

    • Purpose: api for create and retrieve checkout data for payment processing.
    • Data sent: order reference/ID, amount, currency, redirect and return URLs; optionally merchant identifier or email depending on configuration.
    • Terms/Privacy: https://jaja.yellen-corp.com/ (see service terms and privacy policy).

Grow your business by accepting payments through yellen in your WooCommerce store.

The yellen plugin for WooCommerce offers consumers a seamless payment experience with their favourite payment methods in just a few steps. The payments are processed through the yellen payment platform, so you can see them alongside your in-store sales. It’s affordable, easy to set up and use, and simply a better way to get paid.

TAKE PAYMENTS

  • No fixed costs. No binding contracts. Just a small % per transaction
  • Find everything in one place in the yellen Dashboard and App

SUPPORTED PAYMENT METHODS

  • Accept alternative payment methods: Multicaixa Express
  • Request access to Alternative Payment Methods here

STAY SECURE

yellen is authorised as a Payment Institution by the Financial Conduct Authority Emis.
This ensures that payments are processed in accordance with the highest security standards.

BE FLEXIBLE

  • yellen processes in 16 currencies: Kwanza Angolano (AGO),Australian Dollar (AUD), Brazilian Real (BRL), Bulgarian Lev (BGN), Chilean Peso (CLP), Colombian Peso (COP), Czech Koruna (CZK), Danish Krone (DKK), Euro (EUR), Forint (HUF), Norwegian Krone (NOK), Pound Sterling (GBP), Romanian Leu (RON), Swedish Krona (SEK), Swiss Franc (CHF), US Dollar (USD), Zloty (PLZ)
  • yellen supports 22 languages: Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish and Swedish

Want to try it?

GET STARTED

  • Download the plugin
  • Create a free account or use your existing one
  • Verify your account and connect the plugin by using the “Connect Account” button
  • Contact our support team for a test account or to enable necessary scopes when you are ready to accept payments

You’re ready to go.
